features.name: Anonymous suspend overrides and suspend SAM callbacks
features.scope: Anonymous overrides preserve continuation ABI, generic erased bridges and independently resumable frames for every implementation method. Fixed Java callers check primitive, reference, Unit and null results, mutable captures, receiver identity, wide argument slots, direct continuation resume and two suspension points. Suspend SAM values preserve interface identity and do not add the SuspendFunction marker. Same-JVM-carrier override covariance retains the inferred local result type.
restrictions: Capturing enclosing type parameters, Unit-valued suspend SAM parameters and existing unsupported frame shapes remain explicitly diagnosed. Covariance requiring a distinct JVM return carrier remains outside this feature.
